points.text: La **UIT/ITU** es el organismo especializado de las **Naciones Unidas** para las tecnologías de la información y la comunicación (telecomunicaciones).

refs.title: ITU · About ITU
refs.quote: ITU is the United Nations specialized agency for information and communication technologies (ICTs)

points.text: Según el sentido de la transmisión:

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-03-18) · unidirectional
refs.quote: pertaining to a transmission link where the transfer of users' information is possible in one pre-assigned direction only

items.text: **Símplex** (en el uso habitual de los temarios): en **un solo sentido**. La IEC lo llama *unidirectional* (en francés marca *simplex* como desaconsejado aquí), porque reserva *simplex* para el semidúplex.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-03-18) · unidirectional (entrada francesa)
refs.quote: DÉCONSEILLÉ: simplex, adj

items.text: **Semidúplex** (*half-duplex*): en **los dos sentidos, pero no a la vez**. Ojo: la IEC llama a esto *simplex* y desaconseja *half-duplex*.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-03-161) · simplex
refs.quote: pertaining to a method of operation in which information can be transmitted in either direction, but not simultaneously, between two points

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-03-162) · simplex
refs.quote: DEPRECATED: half-duplex, noun

items.text: **Dúplex** (*full duplex*): en **los dos sentidos a la vez**.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-03-171) · duplex
refs.quote: pertaining to a mode of operation in which information can be transmitted in both directions simultaneously between two points

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-03-172) · duplex
refs.quote: DEPRECATED: full duplex, noun

points.text: **Transmisión síncrona**: emisor y receptor funcionan de forma continua con una **diferencia de tiempo constante**. **Arranque-parada** (*start-stop*, lo que suele llamarse transmisión asíncrona): cada carácter o bloque va precedido de una señal de **arranque** y seguido de una de **parada** (la IEC desaconseja «asynchronous» y prefiere *anisochronous*).

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 721-03-05) · synchronous transmission
refs.quote: transmission using isochronous signals in which the sending and receiving instruments are operating continuously in a constant time difference between homologous significant instants

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 721-03-07) · start-stop transmission
refs.quote: each equal length group of signal elements representing a character or a block is preceded by a start signal and is followed by a stop signal

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 702-04-15) · anisochronous
refs.quote: DEPRECATED: asynchronous, adj

points.text: Según los destinatarios:

refs.title: RFC 4291 · IP Version 6 Addressing Architecture
refs.quote: It includes the basic formats for the various types of IPv6 addresses (unicast, anycast, and multicast).

refs.title: RFC 4291 · IP Version 6 Addressing Architecture
refs.quote: A packet sent to a unicast address is delivered to the interface identified by that address.

items.text: **Multidifusión** (*multicast*): a **todos los miembros de un grupo** identificado por una sola dirección.

refs.title: RFC 4291 · IP Version 6 Addressing Architecture
refs.quote: A packet sent to a multicast address is delivered to all interfaces identified by that address.

refs.title: RFC 1112 · Host Extensions for IP Multicasting
refs.quote: IP multicasting is the transmission of an IP datagram to a "host group", a set of zero or more hosts identified by a single IP destination address.

items.text: **Difusión** (*broadcast*): a **todos** los equipos de la red local (en IPv4, 255.255.255.255, que no se reenvía). **IPv6 no tiene broadcast**: lo sustituye la multidifusión.

refs.title: RFC 919 · Broadcasting Internet Datagrams
refs.quote: The address 255.255.255.255 denotes a broadcast on a local hardware network, which must not be forwarded.

refs.title: RFC 4291 · IP Version 6 Addressing Architecture
refs.quote: There are no broadcast addresses in IPv6, their function being superseded by multicast addresses.

items.text: **Anycast**: a **uno** de los destinos que comparten la dirección, el **más cercano** según el enrutamiento.

refs.title: RFC 4291 · IP Version 6 Addressing Architecture
refs.quote: A packet sent to an anycast address is delivered to one of the interfaces identified by that address (the "nearest" one, according to the routing protocols' measure of distance).

refs.title: RFC 4786 · Operation of Anycast Services
refs.quote: Anycast is the name given to the practice of making a Service Address available to a routing system at Anycast Nodes in two or more discrete locations.

sections.title: Redes de comunicaciones: conmutación y difusión

points.text: Por extensión: **LAN** (red local, en las instalaciones del usuario y en un área limitada), **MAN** (une redes locales de una misma **zona urbana**), **WAN** (área mayor que una ciudad; típicamente, un país) y **WPAN** (red personal inalámbrica, de corto alcance, para pocos dispositivos en una sala).

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 732-01-04) · local area network
refs.quote: computer network located on a user’s premises within a limited geographical area

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 732-01-06) · metropolitan area network
refs.quote: network for connecting local area networks located in the same urban area

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 732-01-07) · wide area network
refs.quote: network that provides communication services to a geographic area larger than a single urban area

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 732-01-07) · wide area network
refs.quote: Typically a wide area network covers a single country.

refs.title: NIST CSRC Glossary · wireless personal area network
refs.quote: A small-scale wireless network that requires little or no infrastructure and operates within a short range.

refs.title: NIST CSRC Glossary · wireless personal area network
refs.quote: A WPAN is typically used by a few devices in a single room instead of connecting the devices with cables.

points.text: **Conmutación de circuitos**: se establece una conexión de **uso exclusivo** durante toda la llamada o servicio.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 714-05-08) · circuit switching
refs.quote: to provide a connection for exclusive use of the users for the duration of a call or service

points.text: **Conmutación de paquetes**: el mensaje se divide en **paquetes con dirección** que los nodos reciben, almacenan y reenvían, y se reconstruye en el destino; un paquete ocupa el canal **solo mientras se transmite**. Servicios de la red: **circuito virtual** (simula una conexión de circuitos) y **datagrama** (un mensaje que cabe en un solo paquete se envía al destino que indica la dirección del paquete).

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 714-05-09) · packet switching
refs.quote: the messages are first cut into addressed packets; in certain nodes of the network, these packets are received, stored and forwarded onto the appropriate transmission channels; at the receiving end, the message is reconstituted from the received packets

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 714-05-09) · packet switching
refs.quote: A packet occupies a channel only for its duration of transmission

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 721-16-27) · virtual circuit
refs.quote: that simulate facilities provided by a circuit switched connection

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 721-19-23) · datagram service
refs.quote: a message short enough to be contained in one packet is sent to the destination identified by the packet address

points.text: **Conmutación de mensajes**: se encamina el **mensaje completo**, que se recibe, se almacena si hace falta y se reenvía.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 714-05-10) · message switching
refs.quote: the process of routing complete messages within a telecommunication network by receiving, storing if necessary and forwarding the messages

points.text: **MPLS** (*Multiprotocol Label Switching*): al **entrar** en la red, cada paquete se asigna una sola vez a una clase (**FEC**) y recibe una **etiqueta** corta de longitud fija; en los saltos siguientes no se analiza la cabecera de red, sino que la etiqueta indica el siguiente salto y la nueva etiqueta. Los routers que soportan MPLS son **LSR** (*label switching routers*).

refs.title: RFC 3031 · Multiprotocol Label Switching Architecture
refs.quote: A label is a short, fixed length, locally significant identifier which is used to identify a FEC.

refs.title: RFC 3031 · Multiprotocol Label Switching Architecture
refs.quote: In MPLS, the assignment of a particular packet to a particular FEC is done just once, as the packet enters the network.

refs.title: RFC 3031 · Multiprotocol Label Switching Architecture
refs.quote: At subsequent hops, there is no further analysis of the packet's network layer header. Rather, the label is used as an index into a table which specifies the next hop, and a new label.

refs.title: RFC 3031 · Multiprotocol Label Switching Architecture
refs.quote: A router which supports MPLS is known as a "Label Switching Router", or LSR.

points.text: **Difusión** (radio y televisión): comunicación **unidireccional** para muchos usuarios con receptores adecuados, por radio o cable; es **punto a zona**.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-01-32) · broadcasting
refs.quote: unidirectional telecommunication intended for a large number of users having appropriate receiving facilities, and carried out by means of radio or by cable networks

refs.title: IEC Electropedia (IEV 701-01-32) · broadcasting
refs.quote: Broadcasting is a point-to-area communication.

sections.title: Medios de transmisión y degradación de la señal

points.text: **Atenuación**: disminución de la energía de la señal a medida que se **propaga**.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia · IEV 705-02-05 attenuation (atenuación)
refs.quote: the decrease of the energy of an electromagnetic wave during its propagation

points.text: **Diafonía** (*crosstalk*): aparición de energía no deseada en un canal (p. ej., un par) por la señal de **otro canal**, por inducción, conducción o no linealidad.

refs.title: IEC Electropedia · IEV 722-15-03 crosstalk (diafonía)
refs.quote: the appearance of undesired energy in a channel, owing to the presence of a signal in another channel, caused by, for example induction, conduction or non-linearity

points.text: Cable de pares: **U/UTP** no tiene **ninguna pantalla** (ni global ni por par); **F/UTP** (FTP) tiene pantalla global y **S/FTP** (STP) malla global y pantalla en cada par.

refs.title: Fluke Networks · Acronyms for balanced cables
refs.quote: U/UTP = overall unscreened cable with unscreened twisted pairs (often referred to as UTP)

refs.title: Fluke Networks · Acronyms for balanced cables
refs.quote: F/UTP = overall screened cable with unscreened twisted pairs (often referred to as FTP)

refs.title: Fluke Networks · Acronyms for balanced cables
refs.quote: S/FTP = overall braid screened cable with foil screened twisted pairs (often referred to as STP or PiMF)

points.text: Categorías: la **6A** soporta **10 Gb/s** hasta 100 m; la **8** está pensada para **25GBASE-T y 40GBASE-T** en canales de hasta **30 m**, para centros de datos.

refs.title: Fluke Networks · Ethernet Cable Categories & Speeds Explained
refs.quote: Category 6A—capable of supporting 10 Gb/s to 100 meters—was ratified in 2009.

refs.title: Fluke Networks · Category 8 Cable Testing
refs.quote: the latest twisted-pair copper system designed to support future IEEE 25GBASE-T and 40GBASE-T applications.

refs.title: Fluke Networks · Category 8 Cable Testing
refs.quote: Characterized to 2 GHz and specified for 30-meter, 2-connector channels, Category 8 is intended as a data center application.

points.text: **Fibra óptica de plástico (POF)**: núcleo **grande** (≈1 mm, casi todo núcleo), que facilita acoplar la luz con conectores poco precisos; conectores más baratos y enlaces **cortos** (hasta unos 50 m).

refs.title: The Fiber Optic Association · Plastic Optical Fiber (POF)
refs.quote: POF is large core step-index multimode fiber with a typical diameter of 1 mm, mostly core with a thin cladding.

refs.title: The Fiber Optic Association · Plastic Optical Fiber (POF)
refs.quote: This large core size makes it easy to couple light from LED sources and connectors do not need to be high precision.

refs.title: The Fiber Optic Association · Plastic Optical Fiber (POF)
refs.quote: typical connector costs are 10-20% as much as for glass fibers

refs.title: The Fiber Optic Association · Plastic Optical Fiber (POF)
refs.quote: it is adequate for running short links, such as inside of instruments or within a room for desktop connections up to 50 meters.

points.text: **IEEE 802.11** es la norma de las **redes de área local inalámbricas** (WLAN).

refs.title: IEEE 802.11 Working Group
refs.quote: IEEE 802.11, The Working Group Setting the Standards for Wireless LANs

points.text: **Wi-Fi 6** = **802.11ax**. **Wi-Fi 7** = **802.11be**, que trabaja en las bandas de **2,4, 5 y 6 GHz**.

refs.title: Wi-Fi Alliance · Wi-Fi Alliance introduces Wi-Fi 6
refs.quote: Wi-Fi Alliance® introduces Wi-Fi 6 as the industry designation for products and networks that support the next generation of Wi-Fi®, based on 802.11ax technology.

refs.title: Wi-Fi Alliance · Wi-Fi 7: Advanced connectivity for the next generation
refs.quote: Based on IEEE 802.11be technology, Wi-Fi 7’s unique features offer extremely high throughputs

refs.title: Wi-Fi Alliance · Wi-Fi (MAC/PHY)
refs.quote: Introduced in 2024, Wi-Fi 7 enhances performance across the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands

points.text: **WEP** tiene debilidades criptográficas conocidas y **ya no se considera viable**: es menos seguro que **WPA2**, la especificación de la Wi-Fi Alliance para IEEE 802.11i, que se diseñó para superar las carencias de WEP.

refs.title: NIST SP 800-48 Rev. 1 · Wireless Network Security
refs.quote: WEP is no longer considered a viable encryption mechanism due to known weaknesses.

refs.title: NIST SP 800-48 Rev. 1 · Wireless Network Security
refs.quote: WPA2 is the Wi-Fi Alliance interoperable specification for IEEE 802.11i.

refs.title: NIST SP 800-48 Rev. 1 · Wireless Network Security
refs.quote: the IEEE finalized the 802.11i amendment, which was designed to overcome the shortcomings of WEP

refs.title: NIST SP 800-97 · Establishing Wireless Robust Security Networks
refs.quote: WEP suffers from a number of cryptographic weaknesses that enable attackers with readily available software tools to decipher captured data

points.text: **WPS** (Wi-Fi Protected Setup, hoy Wi-Fi Simple Configuration): métodos de configuración **PIN**, **botón (PBC)**, **NFC** y **USB**.

refs.title: Wi-Fi Alliance · Wi-Fi Protected Setup adds NFC tap-to-connect
refs.quote: Wi-Fi Protected Setup now offers users three easy setup methods – Personal Identification Number (PIN), Push-Button Configuration, and NFC.

refs.title: Microsoft Learn · About Windows Connect Now
refs.quote: Starting with version 2 specification, the specification is named Wi-Fi Simple Configuration (WSC).

refs.title: Microsoft Learn · WCN_VALUE_TYPE_CONFIG_METHODS
refs.quote: USB-A (flash drive) configuration is supported.

points.text: **Piconet**: un dispositivo central y los periféricos enlazados con él. **Scatternet**: **dos o más piconets** con algún dispositivo en común.

refs.title: Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0 · Architecture
refs.quote: A piconet consists of a single Central, known as the Central of the piconet, and all the Peripherals linked to it, known as the Peripherals in the piconet.

refs.title: Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0 · Architecture
refs.quote: Two or more piconets that have one or more devices in common.

points.text: **Bluetooth LE**: 40 canales físicos (3 de anuncio primarios y 37 de uso general). El **anuncio extendido** (Core 5.0) usa **los 40**: los primarios 37, 38 y 39 y los generales 0-36 como secundarios.

refs.title: Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0 · Architecture
refs.quote: For the purposes of data transfer, 40 physical channels, separated by 2 MHz, are used in the FDMA scheme. Three are used as primary advertising channels and 37 are used as general-purpose channels (including as secondary advertising channels).

refs.title: Bluetooth SIG · Bluetooth Core 5.0 Feature Enhancements
refs.quote: Core 5.0 introduces Extended Advertising which uses all 40 Bluetooth LE channels

refs.title: Bluetooth SIG · Bluetooth Core 5.0 Feature Enhancements
refs.quote: with primary advertising channels 37, 38 and 39 carrying less data and general-purpose channels 0 - 36 doing most of the heavy lifting.

sections.title: Redes de baja potencia y área extensa (LPWAN)

points.text: Tecnologías **LPWAN** (enlaces de **varios kilómetros**): **LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, Sigfox** y Wi-SUN FAN. **Bluetooth LE no** está entre ellas: es una de las tecnologías de enlace a las que el grupo 6lo del IETF adapta 6LoWPAN, aparte de las LPWAN.

refs.quote: LoRaWAN is a wireless technology based on Industrial, Scientific, and Medical (ISM) that is used for long-range low-power low-data-rate applications

refs.title: RFC 8376 · Low-Power Wide Area Network (LPWAN) Overview
refs.quote: The Sigfox LPWAN is in line with the terminology and specifications being defined by ETSI
